resources.string: After you launch EastEnders, this helper selects the existing iPlayer profile and newest episode, skips one exact Skip trailer control if offered, then returns Home when playback returns to the programme page. Pausing stays in the player. It observes foreground changes to cancel when you leave iPlayer; it only inspects iPlayer content while armed. It does not intercept remote keys, record screen contents, change settings, or send data anywhere. Turn it off here at any time.
